stopping_state_contract.running_note: While cron is actively scheduled, ledger status may be running; any human-visible stop/checkpoint must map to one of the four report states above.

state_meanings.waiting_gate: Approval or external event is needed; withheld action and resume condition must be recorded.
state_meanings.checkpointed_near_cap: Tool/time/context budget is near cap; checkpoint and next_resume_action are recorded for the next tick.
state_meanings.blocked: Specific local/external blocker prevents all safe local slices; evidence is recorded.
state_meanings.complete: Done condition is verified or user explicitly stops/changes target.
